page.layout: One printed page with two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, left column then right column. Running head above the text, page number at top left.

main_text.p: particulæ à Part. Rad. פֹּה hîc.
אֵפוֹד ephod, cinctura, אֲפֻדָּתוֹ amictus ejus, &c. No. sing. masc. & sing. fœm. constr. aff. Rad. אָפַד amicivit,
אַפִּיל cadere faciam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. נָפַל.
אַפִּיר dispergam, & אֲפִיר irritum faciam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. פּוּר & פּוֹר.
אַפִּיץ fortis, יִם, יְ validi, vires, robora, &c. No. f. & pl. m. constr. Rad. אָפַק fortiter se continere.
אֶפְלָה, אָפֵל, אֻפְלָה cadam, &c. 1. f. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. נָפַל.
אֶפְלָה caligo, אֲפֵלְתְּךָ caligo tua, אֲפֵלוּת caligines, אֶפִילוֹת obscura, &c. No. f. fœm. aff. & pl. fœm. à No. Rad. אָפַל caligo.
רַאֲפֵן & verti me, 1. sing. fut. Kal. Rad. פָּנָה.
אֲפָנִים rotæ, יְ rotæ suæ, &c. pl. m. constr. aff. No. Rad. אֽפַן rota.
אֶפֵס nihilum, אֶפְסַיִם tali pedum, No. sing. & dual. m. Rad. אֶפֶס defsiit, præf. הָאֶפֶס an deficeret.
אֶפְעֶה vipera, No. sing. fœm. Rad. אָפַע.
אֶפְעֶה exclamabo, 1. f. fut. Kal, Rad. פָּעָה.
אֲפָפוּנִי circumdederunt me, præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. R. אָפַף.
אָפֵר irritum faciam, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. R. פּוּר.
אַפְרְחוֹ pulli ejus, (pro יו) אַפְרְחָיו pulli sui, No. pl. m. אֲפַרְחִים pulli avium, aff. R. פָּרַח florere.
וַאֶפַּת & pellectus sum, Jer. 20.7. 1. sing. fut. Niph. def. pro אֶפָּתֶה. Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the right column are small and partly doubtful; the Hebrew forms of several headwords (e.g. אֲפֻדָּתוֹ, אֽפַן, אֶפְסַיִם, וַאֶפַּת) are transcribed from the scan without certainty and should be checked against the original. The page number "28" at top left is read from a small, partly rotated numeral. No marginal notes or catchword are printed.
